{{Quote|Tea wouldn't be my first choice, no. I prefer the harder stuff. Y'know, blue milk, citrus juice, caf&hellip; I once drank two mugs of caf in a single day! It was a wild one.|The [[Alliance Commander]], to [[Ardinondu Dipolus Daeruun]]|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
'''Caf''' was a weak stimulant beverage brewed from [[Caf bean/Legends|caf beans]] native to the [[Planet/Legends|planets]] [[Garqi/Legends|Garqi]] and [[Charra/Legends|Charra]]. On many planets, one could also buy instant caf, but most preferred it brewed the old fashioned way using a [[caf distiller]], or with a [[caf dispenser]]. [[Sugar/Legends|Sugar]], [[Milk/Legends|milk]], [[Cream/Legends|cream]], and [[Sweetener/Legends|sweetener]] could be added to caf in order to vary the taste.

Caf was served at [[caf shop]]s on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]],<ref name="Xw:IR">''[[X-Wing: Isard's Revenge]]''</ref> and the ''[[Oyu'baat]]'' [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] on [[Mandalore/Legends|Mandalore]] served a renowned blend of [[spiced caf]].<ref name="TLJ">[[The Last Jedi (novel)|''The Last Jedi'']]</ref>

The [[Issori]] species were unable to drink caf because their digestive systems were too refined.<ref name="Xw:IR" />

During a conversation over subpar caf with [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]], deposed [[Chief of State (Galactic Alliance)|Chief of State]] [[Nataasi Daala]] expressed her intention to ensure that, upon regaining power, the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorians]] would possess the capability to brew a quality cup of caf. Fett snorted, saying that as long as it kept him sharp, it could "taste like poodoo" for all he cared.<ref name="Ascension">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Ascension]]''</ref>

{{Food-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|Caf? It's a bitter, uh, caffeinated beverage served hot.|[[Khedryn Faal]]|<ref name="Crosscurrent">''[[Crosscurrent]]''</ref>}}
Caf, [[stimcaf]], [[coffeine]], and [[coffee]] are almost certainly meant to be variations of [[Wikipedia:Coffee|coffee]] or [[Wikipedia:Caffeine|caffeine]].
